overloadMerges.note: The docs render two syntax lines that differ only in whether the leading '*' is passed (selecting whether 'object' is an object-name string vs. a form variable reference). That's one semantic overload with an optional literal-symbol discriminator, not two independent overloads. Also fixed oldPosition/newPosition to direction:out per the doc's '<-' arrow column -- the draft parser had defaulted every parameter to direction:in.

params.description: If present, object is a form object name (string); if omitted, object is a variable reference.

params.name: object
params.description: Form object name (if * is passed) or variable reference (if * is omitted), designating the target list box, column, header, or footer.

params.name: oldPosition
params.description: Receives the previous position of the moved row.

params.name: newPosition
params.description: Receives the new position of the moved row.

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Reports, via the two output parameters, the previous and new position of the row the user just moved; intended for use inside the On Row Moved form event.

constraints: Must be called from the On Row Moved form event.
Only applies to array-type list boxes (rows can only be moved there).
Does not take hidden/displayed row states into account.
